final_text:
Five of the ten spiked organisms reach the 10-read threshold at species level. I read the report directly and did not use the `mockcheck` tool.

| Organism | Species clade reads | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Enterococcus faecalis | 6457 | detected |
| Pseudomonas aeruginosa | 811 | detected |
| Escherichia coli | 72 | detected |
| Staphylococcus aureus | 54 | detected |
| Limosilactobacillus fermentum (manifest: Lactobacillus fermentum) | 26 | detected |
| Salmonella enterica | 4 | missed |
| Bacillus subtilis | 2 | missed |
| Listeria monocytogenes | no species-level row | missed |
| Saccharomyces cerevisiae | no species-level row | missed |
| Cryptococcus neoformans | no species-level row | missed |

For Listeria, the report only has genus and family rows (315 reads at genus level), with no *L. monocytogenes* species row. Saccharomyces and Cryptococcus have no matching rows at all. I counted a missing species row as a miss, since the data shows no species-level reads for it.

RESULT: {"detected": ["pseudomonas aeruginosa", "escherichia coli", "lactobacillus fermentum", "enterococcus faecalis", "staphylococcus aureus"], "missed": ["salmonella enterica", "listeria monocytogenes", "bacillus subtilis", "saccharomyces cerevisiae", "cryptococcus neoformans"]}
